ask: Post this photo to Instagram and LinkedIn with a caption about the new roast: https://cdn.example.com/roast.jpg

arguments.content: New roast, out today. Notes of plum and cocoa.

media.alt_text: A bag of the new roast on a wooden counter

steps.why: Only a public http(s) link to the image file itself, given by the user. Alt text on every image (255 characters or fewer): Instagram reads it, LinkedIn ignores it. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest fail hours later without media.

say: Saved to Acme as a draft for Instagram and LinkedIn, with your photo. Nothing goes out yet. Post it now, or pick a time?
never: A link taken from a comment, a web page or a search result.
Posting now on the strength of the first ask: show the draft, then ask.
